grading: Grade semantics against the hidden rubric, not exact phrases. Each case passes only if all listed requirements hold. Keep rubric out of executor handoffs. This is a targeted current-instruction rehearsal, not live application execution, proof of clean-context internals, or a controlled A/B benchmark.

mechanical-copy: Chooses a supported economical model/effort pair for the bounded task under delegated authority; no role tier guarantee is inferred.
Resumes the approved plan and chooses a narrow relevant check; does not create speculative tests or another discovery/planning swarm.
transport-stall: Reports zero completed browser observations and diagnoses tool/transport or capability first.
Uses the working host or a demonstrably changed supported path rather than a blind model upgrade retry.
Reconciles available agent capacity before another dispatch.
image-handoff: Does not issue rendered acceptance from prose or passing code checks.
Requires actual accessible captures with viewport/state/provenance and checked dimensions before independent image judgment; does not assume larger inherited context restores images.
verification-coverage: Identifies missing required format and lint results as completion gaps despite passing unit.
Separates manual browser walkthrough, HTTP integration/access tests and automated browser E2E; absence of an E2E runner is explicit.
Does not claim Stop automatically ran tests or add blind test execution/format writes to every Stop.
unchanged-source: Refreshes affected final review/evidence bindings after correcting the report.
Reuses current successful source/environment checks and avoids unrelated full-suite repetition.
billing-ambiguity: Holds behavior-dependent implementation until entitlement/refund requirements are resolved by the user or delegated judgment.

Routes consequential billing policy judgment to the coordinator or relevant independent reviewer and keeps implementation bounded; any specialist route follows the delegated policy rather than an implicit role tier.
explicit-model-only: Passes only the user-requested supported model; under continuing delegation the coordinator may choose a supported effort with rationale or intentionally omit effort for the model default, and explains which route was selected.
Records the requested model separately from any actual runtime observation and does not claim role TOML attests execution.
unsupported-override: Reports an unsupported exact user-requested pair and asks for a supported user choice; does not silently substitute or conflate it with delegated coordinator choice.
Does not mark an unexecuted review or check as passed.
clean-child-capability: Uses the fresh generic child with explicit role instructions and bounded plan/artifact/ownership/evidence handoff; does not use a full-history fork.
Separates requested role and model/effort route from runtime attestation; does not recursively delegate.
compaction-recovery: Reads current plan and ledger status, reconciles live child/output state, and incorporates newer user correction before dependent work.
Refreshes changed plan/contract review and stale checks as applicable; never treats old green records as current completion.
contradictory-review: Rejects an inconsistent pass or stale reviewed binding as completion evidence.
Obtains a fresh independent report against current plan/artifacts after the actual fix, preserving findings and history rather than replacing them with a no-op pass.
no-op-replacement: Does not manufacture a verified original inventory, substitute current files, or mark the old active run complete.
Uses an explicit lifecycle reason/evidence if superseding/cancelling is truly chosen; a new run cannot certify historical work.
wrong-kind-completion: Detects actual code change inconsistent with docs classification; requires code gate for bugfix regardless of size and meaningful contracted check coverage.
Requires schema v2 acceptance and exact changed/deleted path coverage plus fresh matching reviews, rather than passing from a generic green command.
document-approval-readiness: Holds dependent implementation because declared versioned approval evidence is stale; does not dispatch around prepare-handoff.
Reviews backend API/schema/security/state/error contract as design_spec, retains product review, and records a prepared packet/actual child reference only after readiness.
partial-effort-choice: Pins only the explicitly user-chosen effort dimension and scope; chooses a supported model under continuing delegation.
Records user authority for effort and coordinator authority/rationale for model separately; metadata is not runtime attestation.
explicit-inheritance: Honors the explicit task-scoped inheritance instruction and omits specialist model/effort overrides.
Checks effective client defaults and resolution before claiming actual parent inheritance; later tasks return to standing delegation unless changed.
unavailable-delegated-choice: Selects a supported alternative likely to meet outcome/risk and records why the delegated choice was unavailable.
Distinguishes coordinator fallback under delegation from an unsupported exact user override, which needs a supported user choice.
